status: Voices of the six players as in the clip: Gemini TTS voice + style per character; voice/rate/pitch = the free Edge voice (also used when Gemini fails).
engine: edge-tts (Microsoft Edge neural voices, free, no key)

fah.name: น้องฟ้า
fah.style: Thai high-school girl. Cheerful, quick and energetic, teen slang, a little dramatic, pointing fingers playfully.

wit.name: ครูวิทย์
wit.style: Thai science teacher in his forties. Polite, measured and serious, logical, precise, like laying out evidence in class.

muay.name: เจ๊หมวย
muay.style: Thai grocery-shop owner woman in her forties. Sharp-tongued, sarcastic, suspicious and blunt, sassy eye-rolling tone.

tee.name: ตี๋
tee.style: Thai teenage gamer boy. Cheeky and teasing, short clipped sentences, casual, a bit lazy-sounding but sharp.

win.name: พี่วิน
win.style: Thai motorbike-taxi rider in his thirties: fast, loose street talk, friendly teasing, laughs easily, very casual.

khem.name: สารวัตรเข้ม
khem.style: Thai police inspector in his late forties: deep, firm, unhurried voice of someone used to interrogations. Short clipped sentences, stern, rarely smiles.

gemini.models_note: tried in this order; a model over its daily cap (429 'per day') is skipped until its reset. Probed 2026-10-18: all 5 work with this key; only the two 3.8 models accept the style annotation.
gemini.daily_caps_note: requests per day per model, project 'Minecraft Project', Tier 1 - read by VreKi from aistudio.google.com/rate-limit on 2026-10-18 (screenshot). Every TTS model there: 10 RPM, 10K input TPM.
gemini.prices_note: USD per 1M tokens [input, audio output], paid tier, read 2026-10-18 from ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing; doubles on 2027-01-01
